name: com.ericjrico.ui-toolkit-extensions
description: High-performance UI Toolkit extensions for Unity, including a zero-dependency stacked bar graph visualization.

samples.description: Multi-panel runtime gallery showcasing all BarGraph features with per-panel controls, up to 1000 stacked segments, and live streaming.
EditorWindow gallery with animation playback, all dataset types, and up to 1000 stacked segments with HSL color rotation.
Four game-themed panels demonstrating custom visual styling: damage meter, resource economy, performance profiler, and leaderboard.
